title: avd-assessment-review/v1: a person's decision on each finding of one assessment (review.json)
description: Contract C23, written by avd-current-state's assessment portal. It pins the C21 report it reviews by hash and records, per check, what the reviewer decided: fix it, accept it with a reason, or defer it. Reasons are codes, never free text; a reviewer's notes stay in their private notes file. It holds no names or IDs, only the estate pseudonym and check IDs, and works without the brain or avd-swarm, which may import it (optional extensions only).

estate.description: The same pseudonym as the C21 report

assessment.description: The C21 report reviewed: the SHA-256 of its bytes and its generatedUtc

decisions.description: At most one row per check of the report (tests/check_contracts.py checks the examples for duplicates). A check with no row is not reviewed yet; a plan treats it as fix when its outcome isn't pass.

outcome.description: The outcome the reviewer saw. A later report with a different outcome for the check asks for a new decision.

reviewBy.description: Optional: when an accepted or deferred finding should be looked at again

carriedForward.description: true when the portal copied this decision from an earlier review because the outcome didn't change; it asks for a second look

extensions.description: Optional, for upper layers only, keyed by namespace (contracts/README.md rule 1). A foundation reader ignores it.
